tags.name: Mock Access Data Store — Prior Authority
tags.description: Mock of the Access Data Store endpoint that accepts prior-authority submissions.

tags: Mock Access Data Store — Prior Authority
post.summary: Submit a prior-authority request against an application
post.description: Accepts a prior-authority submission for the given application. Repeated submissions for the same applicationId return the same submission ID (idempotent).

parameters.name: applicationId
parameters.description: ID of the application this prior-authority request is for.

201.description: Submission accepted by the Access Data Store.

400.description: Validation failed on the submission body.

EstimatedTime.description: Estimated time required to carry out the work, in hours and minutes.

PriorAuthoritySubmission.description: Prior-authority request body as submitted to the Access Data Store. The applicationId is taken from the URL path; it does not appear in the body.

type.description: The category of prior authority being requested.

expertFullName.description: Full name of the expert the prior authority is for.

uploadedDocuments.description: Supporting documents uploaded with the request.

guidelineRatesExceeded.description: True if the requested rates exceed the published LAA guideline rates.

billingType.description: How the work will be billed.

hourlyRate.description: Hourly rate in GBP. Required when billingType is HOURLY.

estimatedTime.description: Estimated time the work will take. Required when billingType is HOURLY.

totalAmount.description: Total amount in GBP for hourly billing. Required when billingType is HOURLY.

flatRateTotalAmount.description: Total flat-rate amount in GBP. Required when billingType is FLAT_RATE.

UploadedDocument.description: A document uploaded as supporting evidence for a prior-authority request.

PriorAuthorityApplicationResponse.description: Confirmation returned after a prior-authority application has been submitted.

submissionId.description: Identifier assigned to the prior-authority application by the Access Data Store.

submittedAt.description: Timestamp the application was accepted by the Access Data Store.
